resources.string: HOW TO USE (like PayBack + WePlay): Tap 🔊 PAYBACK preset → START. Your mic is played out the SPEAKER at max volume with echo + doubling, so the room hears it. Then open WePlay / voice room with its mic picking up the speaker — your voice gets boosted + doubled twice. For max room-tremble use 🏚 ROOM SHAKER (feedback ramps up over ~30s). Keep the phone 1-2 ft away to avoid painful squeal.
